_about: Which pending protocol revisions touch market design, pricing or mitigation, judged from each request's title and description. A request the IMM has commented on, or stated a supporting opinion on, is flagged automatically.

notes.NPRR1214: Changes the real-time reliability deployment price adder to send locational price signals.
notes.NPRR1255: Sets mitigated offer caps for energy storage resources.
notes.NPRR1278: Would create a new ancillary service for grid support from inverter-based resources.
notes.NPRR1292: Creates more granular congestion revenue right products.
notes.NPRR1296: Creates a residential demand response program.
notes.NPRR1310: Builds out Dispatchable Reliability Reserve Service (IMM recommendation 2021-2).
notes.NPRR1328: Implements the generation firming program. The IMM filed in the firming rulemaking (Project 58198).
notes.NPRR1335: Implements the commission's Firm Fuel Supply Service rule (IMM recommendation 2025-1).
notes.NPRR1338: Restructures the long-term congestion revenue right auctions.
notes.NPRR1340: Adds energy storage to Dispatchable Reliability Reserve Service (IMM recommendation 2021-2).
notes.NPRR1342: Sets mitigated offer caps for contract-for-capacity resources.
notes.NPRR1343: Charges a fee on inefficient point-to-point bids (IMM recommendation 2020-4).
notes.NPRR1345: Extends the exceptional fuel cost process, which feeds mitigated offers.
notes.NPRR1346: Raises the fuel oil price adder used in cost-based offers.
